data.body: Prevention ticket for the recurring autodeploy path-manifest drift class. Four confirmed instances to date: 1d1b (downy-feminist-leopard, nginx edge), 5524 (satiated-activated-aardwolf, host-nginx materializers — the class-review origin), 5d4c (broke-choleric-hound, mcp-entrypoint.sh) and 408c (sunbeamy-uber-polliwog, materialize-deploy-key.sh). The last two landed together in f87719be9999. Design (derive-and-diff anchored to Dockerfile/compose directives + filename conventions, fail-safe exclusion list, wired into `make lint`) approved by the operator over a bare curated list.
